Notes_and_Tips: Since thyroid and PCOS are present, keep meal timings regular even if appetite is low.
Late nights can increase fried cravings, so keep makhana ready instead of fried snacks.
Make paneer or dal the main part of meals to support hormone balance and steady energy.
Keep dinner lighter to improve digestion and sleep quality.
Simple home style cooking will help maintain consistency long term.
